evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Nicole asked 'do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?' after probing, not the two-concerns opener before probing started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concern at step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never addressed. Nicole quoted the customer for Monday October 26th without identifying the value branch or offering alternative days at lower cost.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Nicole said 'And to secure a spot, there's no deposit record if you have to reschedule or cancel no fees for that either. And would you like me to get you on the schedule.' Rate lock and no-deposit mentioned before the ask for the business.

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (addresses, floor levels, elevator access, walking distances at both ends, room count, item descriptions, box count) and delivered a personalized estimate ($908–$1,100) anchored to the customer's specific move profile (third-floor apartment, basement storage, long walks).
coaching_note: Ask the two-concerns question early, before any probing starts — 'most of them have one of two concerns: either the movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items' — so you can address what actually matters to the customer rather than moving straight into logistics.
